task: Classify histologic subtype in non-small cell lung cancer. Classes: lung squamous cell carcinoma vs. lung adenocarcinoma. Distinguishing H&E features include keratinization and intercellular bridges for squamous carcinoma versus gland formation, acinar or lepidic patterns, and intracellular or extracellular mucin for adenocarcinoma.

classes.0: Lung squamous cell carcinoma showing polygonal cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, keratinization, or intercellular bridges.
classes.1: Lung adenocarcinoma showing glandular differentiation, acinar or lepidic architecture, or mucin production.
